name: Podcast show notes writer
why: Turns a transcript into a title, summary, key points, links and a call to action, the core of the show-notes-and-transcript skill.

name: Interview transcript trimmer
why: Cuts a long interview transcript down to the passages worth using, in the speaker's own words, for picking best moments and clips.

name: Cut a raw recording and get chapters and short clips
why: Gives a timed cut list, chapters and short clips from a raw recording, a good start before checking chapters against Apple and Spotify rules.

name: Cut, chapter and clip a long video into five shorts
why: For video podcasts: a cut list, chapters and five short clips with new first lines from the recording transcript.

name: Video audio finishing plan
why: Plans voice, music, effects, fades and mix checks, useful when briefing an editor before the loudness check.

name: Monthly content repurposer
why: Picks last month's best episodes and turns them into posts, emails and clips to approve, alongside the monthly show review.

name: Rough text to article tidier
why: Turns an episode transcript into a tidy article with headings, keeping the speakers' words, for a blog version of an episode.

name: Interview question set maker
why: Builds structured question sets; adapt its method for guest questions with follow-ups in the episode plan.

name: Suno song and music bed prompt writer
why: Writes prompts for original intro music and beds; check the tool's licence terms and log the track in the rights log.

name: ElevenLabs spoken script writer
why: Writes spoken scripts for AI voice-over; use only with voices the client owns or has written consent for, and disclose synthetic voices.
